EUR, converted exactly from € millions. LEADER: Hasso Plattner, a cofounder, left the Supervisory Board on May 15, 2024; the FY2025 20-F mentions him only in historical compensation tables (as Supervisory Board chairperson until May 15, 2024, and as a former Executive Board member). Its major-shareholder table (as of February 5, 2026) covers 5% holders and current board members only and does not list him, his foundation or family vehicles. No holding is reported, so status is 'no-reported-stake'. This does not mean he holds no SAP shares; the filing simply gives no figure. HOLDERS: percentages are '% of Outstanding' ordinary shares as reported to SAP. Dietmar Hopp's 5.1% rests on a Schedule 13G filed February 11, 2022, and BlackRock's 6.3% on a 13G filed February 2, 2024 (BlackRock told SAP it still holds more than 5% but gave no count); asOf uses those filing dates because the 20-F gives no event dates. Dietmar Hopp is another SAP cofounder, not part of Plattner's holdings. BUYBACKS: €1,937 million 'Purchase of treasury shares' in the 2025 cash-flow statement. SAP announced a new buyback of up to €10 billion in January 2026, after the fiscal year. STOCK COMP: €1,695 million total share-based payment expense (equity- and cash-settled). GEOGRAPHY: the six country/sub-region rows; EMEA, Americas and APJ subtotals are not repeated.
